hints.title: Index Retention
hints.text: Pair each interval with its original index before sorting by start boundaries.

hints.title: Next Disjoint Search
hints.text: Use binary search on sorted start coordinates to locate the earliest non-overlapping successor.

hints.title: Lexicographical Tie-Breaking
hints.text: Track maximum weight and resolve identical scores by taking the lexicographically smaller sorted index list.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting and binary search queries across 4 capacity DP states in O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive subset generation takes O(n^4) which times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memoization table stores weight and index sets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines weighted interval scheduling DP with binary search and lexicographical list tie-breaking.
